name: Web
description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within range. A creature caught in the webs must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained as long as it remains in the webs or until it breaks free with a Strength check.
effect: A creature that fails a Dexterity save is restrained in sticky webs until it tears free.
notes: In combat: on a failed Dexterity save the target is restrained: it can't move, its attacks have disadvantage and attacks against it have advantage. It tries to tear free (Strength) at the end of each of its turns. Concentration, 10 rounds.
